    About this data

    Source declarations are XML documents published by Bulgaria’s Court of Audit (Сметна палата) at register.cacbg.bg, covering asset and interest declarations required by law from senior public officials. This analysis parsed declarations from individuals filed between 2015 and 2026, including corrections to earlier filings.

    Figures shown are exactly as declared, in Bulgarian lev (BGN). The underlying register occasionally contains obvious data-entry errors from the source filings (a wrong digit, a misplaced decimal); a small number of implausible outliers were excluded from the “notable movers” list above for readability, but are retained in the full underlying dataset. Where an official held two concurrent roles, or two different people share an identical name, figures are attributed using workplace as well as name to avoid conflating them — though this cannot fully resolve cases with no public identifier, only a name.

    “Median declared income” and the search feature include only officials with a computed fiscal year between 2015 and 2026; a small number of declarations with missing or evidently mistyped years are excluded throughout.

    Built as an independent data engineering project. Source code and pipeline: a personal Databricks project, not affiliated with the Court of Audit.
